story.title: (ENR SUCC) DEV & TEST - 834E/U AR PASSE Transaction Effective Date Logic Update - EDI

scenarios.title: Future eligibility transaction uses Eligibility Date as transaction effective date
Current eligibility with Assessment Date changed uses Assessment Date
Current eligibility with relevant field changes and unchanged Assessment Date uses Maintenance Date
Maintenance Date is not used for future eligibility when Assessment Date changes
gaps: TC_002 is the closest related case, but the scenario description also requires "Conditions to cover: 1) Future eligibility file contains Eligibility Date, changed Assessment Date, and Maintenance Date, and Maintenance Date is not used because the member’s eligibility span has not yet begun. 2) Future eligibility file contains Eligibility Date and unchanged Assessment Date with no relevant-field change, and Maintenance Date is not used because the member’s eligibility span has not yet begun." Each test case is expected to map to exactly one entry; this case covers condition 2, so add a dedicated test case for the other listed condition if this case is being used alone.

scenarios.title: Maintenance Date is not used for current eligibility when only Assessment Date changes
gaps: semantic duplicate: TC_002 "Validate that an AR PASSE inbound 834 current-eligibility update containing both a changed Assessment Date and a present Maintenance Date does not use Maintenance Date as the transaction effective date and does not create a new eligibility split on the Maintenance Date." shares the same business intent as TC_001 "Validate that an AR PASSE inbound 834 daily update for a member whose eligibility span already began uses the changed Assessment Date as the transaction effective date, does not split the current span by Maintenance Date..."; TC_001 already covers "Maintenance Date 2025-07-15 in Loop 2000 DTP*303" and asserts "no row is created with SBEL_EFF_DT = 2025-07-15" and "the current eligibility span is not split at 2025-07-15".

scenarios.title: Date identification and selective population remain backward compatible
gaps: Scenario coverage gap for TC_002: scenario description field says "Conditions to cover: 1) File contains identifiable Eligibility Date, Assessment Date, and Maintenance Date and the applicable rule path selects Eligibility Date for transaction effective date. 2) File contains identifiable Eligibility Date, Assessment Date, and Maintenance Date and the applicable rule path selects Assessment Date for transaction effective date. 3) File contains identifiable Eligibility Date, Assessment Date, and Maintenance Date and the applicable rule path selects Maintenance Date for transaction effective date." The full acceptance criteria text also requires "Given an inbound EDI 834 file, if the Assessment Date has changed and none of the relevant fields have changed, the Assessment Date populates as the transaction effective date, maintaining values of relevant fields." Add a dedicated test case for it.

scenarios.title: Finance-impact regression confirms selective date logic across supported rule paths
gaps: Coverage completeness: scenario also requires "Given an inbound EDI 834 file, if the Assessment Date has changed and none of the relevant fields have changed, the Assessment Date populates as the transaction effective date, maintaining values of relevant fields." Add a dedicated test case for it. Attached to closest related case TC_002.

Coverage completeness: scenario also requires "Given an inbound EDI 834 file, if the member’s eligibility span has not yet begun and any relevant fields have changed but Assessment Date has NOT changed, the Eligibility Date populates as the transaction effective date." Add a dedicated test case for it. Attached to closest related case TC_003.

Coverage completeness: scenario also requires "Given an inbound EDI 834 file, if the member’s eligibility span has already begun and any relevant fields have changed but Assessment Date has NOT changed, the Maintenance Date (DTP*303) populates as the transaction effective date." Add a dedicated test case for it. Attached to closest related case TC_004.
